futureChoices.title: 说话时才决定/承诺
futureChoices.example: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.

futureChoices.title: 眼前证据预测
futureChoices.example: Look at the clouds. It's going to rain.

futureChoices.title: 个人安排已落实
futureChoices.example: I'm meeting the supplier at ten.

futureChoices.title: 未来某时的过程
futureChoices.example: At ten, I'll be meeting the buyer.

futureChoices.title: 马上发生/正式安排
futureChoices.formula: be about to / be due to / be to
futureChoices.example: The meeting is about to start.

futureNote: 未来时间/条件从句：when / if / as soon as / until 后通常用一般现在时。I'll call you when I arrive. 不说 when I will arrive。

comparePairs.title: 一般过去 vs 现在完成

right.label: 结果连接现在
right.example: I have sent it, so check your inbox.

comparePairs.title: 现在完成 vs 完成进行

right.label: 过程/时长
right.example: I have been writing for two hours.

comparePairs.title: 过去进行 vs 过去完成进行

right.label: 到过去某时已持续
right.example: I had been working for two hours by eight.

comparePairs.title: 过去完成 vs 一般过去

left.label: 更早发生
left.example: I had sent it before she called.

comparePairs.title: 现在进行表未来 vs 将来进行

right.label: 届时过程/行程
right.example: I'll be meeting her at ten.

grammarLinks.title: 主被动
grammarLinks.desc: 先定时态，再把 be 放进该时态，最后加 done。
grammarLinks.example: is checked · was being checked · has been checked · will have been checked

grammarLinks.title: 过去情态判断
grammarLinks.desc: 现在判断过去发生了什么。
grammarLinks.example: must have done 一定做了 · can't have done 不可能做了 · should have done 本应做

grammarLinks.title: 状态动词
grammarLinks.desc: know / own / belong / need 等通常不使用进行时。语义变成动作时可例外。
grammarLinks.example: I think = 我认为；I'm thinking about it = 我正在考虑

grammarLinks.title: 时间与条件从句
grammarLinks.desc: 谈未来时，从句通常用一般现在时，主句再表达未来。
grammarLinks.example: I'll call when I arrive. · If it rains, we'll stay inside.

grammarLinks.title: 间接引语
grammarLinks.desc: 过去转述常后移：will → would；have done → had done。事实仍成立时可不后移。
grammarLinks.example: She said she would call. · He said the Earth goes around the Sun.

grammarLinks.title: 条件句 / 虚拟
grammarLinks.desc: 真实可能：if + 一般现在；现在虚拟：if + 过去式；过去虚拟：if + had done。
grammarLinks.example: If I had known, I would have acted.（事实：当时不知道，也没行动）

recallPills.label: 一般
recallPills.desc: 动作是整体、事实、习惯或完整事件
recallPills.formula: do / did / will do / would do

recallPills.label: 进行
recallPills.desc: 镜头在动作内部，看到过程正在展开

recallPills.label: 完成
recallPills.desc: 站在截止点回看，之前已有结果

recallPills.label: 完成进行
recallPills.desc: 站在截止点回看，之前已经持续

recallQuestions: 我站在现在、过去、未来，还是过去看后来？
我看的是整体、过程、此前完成，还是此前持续？
我要强调成果数量，还是过程时长？
主语做动作，还是承受动作？
recallTip: 准确的时态不是「背出名字」，而是让听者清楚：事情发生在哪里、进行到哪一步、与哪个时间点相连。
